  Function: main
  Purpose: To determine if a given string meets specific criteria related to the case of its characters.
  Signature: main(String[] args)
  Input: A single command-line argument, which is a string input from the user via standard input.
  Output: A string output to the console, either "Yes" or "No".
  Behavior:
    1. Initialize a Scanner object to read input from the standard input stream.
    2. Read the next token from the input as a string `s`.
    3. Check if the first character of `s` is an uppercase letter. If not, print "No" and terminate the program.
    4. Iterate over the characters of `s` starting from the second character up to the second-to-last character (bug is here).
    5. For each character in the iteration, check if it is a lowercase letter. If any character is not lowercase, print "No" and terminate the program.
    6. If all characters meet the criteria, print "Yes".
]

Repair Directions:
1. Modify the iteration to include all characters from the second character to the last character of the string.
2. Ensure that the check for lowercase characters applies to all characters after the first one.
